from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document for matching against predefined results."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The document title as given")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document: appeal judgment, retrial ruling, penalty review decision, etc.")
    party_names: list[str] = Field(description="All named parties/parties involved")
    appellant_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the appellant if present")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case: property dispute, inheritance, execution objection, penalty review, etc.")
    court_decision: str | None = Field(description="Main ruling content: 驳回上诉/驳回再审申请/撤销罚款/etc.")
    court_decision_type: str | None = Field(description="Standardized decision type: 驳回上诉维持原判/驳回再审申请/撤销决定/etc.")
    case_fee_amount: float | None = Field(description="Case fee amount in yuan if mentioned, None if not")
    case_fee_bearer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the case fee, if specified")
    judgment_final: bool | None = Field(description="Whether this is a final judgment: True/False/None")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
